title: the inheritance
premise: Your grandmother left her house to you, not to your mother. Your mother found out at the reading of the will, an hour ago. She's waiting in the car.
setting: A small coastal town in early spring, a solicitor's office, then a long drive along the cliffs.
tone: restrained family drama with sudden warmth

self.description: You spent every summer at your grandmother's house.
self.want: To keep the house without losing your mother.
self.avoids: Telling your mother why your grandmother did it.

cast.name: Marguerite
cast.description: Proud, wounded, and sharper than ever when she's hurt.
cast.want: To understand why her mother passed her over.
cast.avoids: Talking about the last time she visited.
cast.closeness: you were close until you were fifteen
cast.tension: she and her mother didn't speak for nine years

opening.title: The summers
opening.description: Every summer until you were eighteen, you stayed with your grandmother by the sea.

opening.title: The phone call
opening.description: Last month your grandmother told you on the phone, "it has to be you, and you'll know why."

opening.title: The car
opening.description: Your mother sits in the passenger seat, engine off, staring straight ahead.

background: Your grandmother left you a letter you haven't opened.
Your mother tried to sell the house once, years ago.
